title: Austin Considers December Tax Appeals
summary:
*   Austin city officials convened for a special meeting.
*   The entire agenda was dedicated solely to considering various tax appeals.
*   Officials gathered to review and make decisions on citizens' property tax disputes.

=CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Notice is hereby given that a
Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin will be held on the 21st day of
December 1965, at theMunicipal Building, Eighth and Colorado, in Austin, Texas at 2:30
P.M. for the purpose of considering tax appeals.
s/ Elsie Woosley
